I've looped in Laura (Customer Success lead) and Grace (Capacity engineering) to coordinate the sizing validation and runbook. Hi Priya — quick answers from capacity: 
- Canary will be pinned to the quantized variant intended for Dedicated during the dry-run. We'll validate end-to-end perf against the same kernel/config.
- We support region-aware rollouts. For safety, our recommended path is: route 100% of US-west traffic to Dedicated during the swap while keeping read replicas in other regions pointing to Hosted (failback available). If Emerald prefers a gradual regional rollout, we can do staged region-by-region cutovers but that extends the swap window.

Sizing notes (summary from the model):
- Baseline (p50): 8xA100-80GB equiv for sustained throughput (8 GPU pods)
- Peak headroom (p95/spikes): add 4x transient capacity (burst pool) to cover short-term spikes up to ~2.6M tokens/day
- Cache expected to reduce token compute by ~18% on average; with caching, recommended base is 7xA100 + 3xburst.

I'll run a short performance verification this week in staging and upload traces to the shared Drive link. If you can confirm synthetic traffic windows, I'll schedule the staging runs.

Grace O'Connor
Capacity Engineer — Redwood Inference
